criteria.text: Every factual claim in the ANSWER that the REFERENCE covers agrees with the REFERENCE.
Every fact the REFERENCE marks as required for a correct answer is present in the ANSWER.
No statement in the ANSWER contradicts the REFERENCE.

description: UNCALIBRATED reference rubric: not calibrated by Gentlity, no accuracy claim. PASS means no contradiction with the supplied reference and required facts present; not that the answer is correct in general.
